verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's marketing pages describe first-party AI agents for customer screening/ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. These agents work on the user's own alert data: they auto-remediate level 1 alerts and escalate high-risk or complex cases for human review. That is AI acting on customer data inside the product, but the evidence shows automated triage and actions rather than insights or suggestions presented to the user, and it rests on thin marketing snippets. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or explanations shown to analysts, recommendation or suggestion surfaces in the case UI, in-depth first-party docs on the agents' outputs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
